messages.content: Write a Python function `merge_intervals(intervals)` that merges overlapping intervals in a list of [start, end] pairs and returns the merged list sorted by start. Include a docstring, type hints and three example calls with their expected output in comments. Reply with the code only.
Explain how a refrigerator keeps food cold, for a curious twelve-year-old, in about 250 words.
Write an original short story of about 300 words about a lighthouse keeper who receives a letter that was posted fifty years ago. Make the ending surprising.

Turn this into a JSON array of objects with the keys name, role, city and start_year. Reply with the JSON only.
